Today on Sky Sports Racing: Hereford hosts six-race card
The Sky Sports Racing cameras head to Hereford today, with a six-race National Hunt card on the agenda. In the feature contest, Lightning Flash looks to strike again for the Twiston-Davies team.
Wednesday 11 November 2026 11:28, UK
Don't miss six races from Hereford on Tuesday, live on Sky Sports Racing.
1.40 Hereford - Lightning Flash seeks another success
Lightning Flash bids to follow up in this Copybet For Nations League Profit Boosts Handicap Hurdle at Hereford.
The Nigel and Willy Twiston-Davies-trained runner had been struggling over fences before bouncing back to form with a dominant success over hurdles at Market Rasen last month. Now a three-time winner, he must be feared but will need more under this 7lb penalty.
Mr Jukebox opened his account over hurdles when comfortably winning at Exeter and was only narrowly beaten when second at Perth in April. He remains unexposed over jumps and rates the chief threat with Caoilin Quinn booked.
Lydeard Girl is yet to win over hurdles but put up an improved display at Wincanton and merits respect as she drops back in distance. City Of Diamonds is now 5lbs below his last winning mark and could bounce back to form when stepped up in trip for Clive Boultbee-Brooks.
2.50 Hereford - In-form Seraphic bids to continue fine form
Seraphic bids for another victory in this Copybet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle at 2.50pm.
The David Killahena & Graeme McPherson-trained six-year-old followed up his Southwell victory with an easy success at Huntingdon 15 days ago and looks the obvious play in this similar heat. A 4lb rise might not stop him landing a hat-trick, although he is entered for a Tuesday assignment at Warwick prior to this.
Zenato, a three-time winner over hurdles, disappointed when pulled up on his return at Uttoxeter but is just 2lb higher than his last winning mark.
Others to note include No Hard Feelings and Taritino. The latter scored on his latest hurdles run back in April and is fit from a summer on the level.
12.30 Hereford - Debut scorer Echo Valley faces Koala Rose
Echo Valley and Koala Rose clash in an intriguing Copybet Back Again At Hereford Fillies' Juvenile Hurdle that opens the card.
Tom Symond's Echo Valley made a winning debut over this course and distance when seeing off Aukus last month and having taken well to this discipline she should make a bold bid despite conceding weight to her three rivals.
Dan Skelton saddles Koala Rose, who reached a mark of 77 on the flat and looks an exciting recruit to the jumping game. A daughter of Australia, she looks the one to beat granted a clear round.
Jamie Snowden's Princess Of Habo cannot be ruled out having shown a fair level of ability in Germany.
digest_he:
היום מתקיים במסלול Hereford אירוע הכולל שישה מירוצי מכשולים שונים מסוג National Hunt, אשר יועברו בשידור חי ב-Sky Sports Racing. במוקד האירוע, הסוס Lightning Flash בהדרכת צוות Twiston-Davies מנסה לרשום הצלחה נוספת לאחר ניצחון מרשים ב-Market Rasen בחודש שעבר.

מלבד זאת, מירוצים נוספים כוללים מתמודדים בולטים כמו Mr Jukebox, Lydeard Girl ו-Seraphic הנמצא בכושר מצוין ושואף להשלים רצף ניצחונות מרשים. הצופים והאוהדים יכולים לצפות ליום מתחרה ומעניין במסלול המירוצים הבריטי.
